subject: engineering-simplicity
scenario: No agent in this organization holds the Skill tool, so a skill no role preloads cannot be reached by any role. A cross-cutting principle that reaches nobody is worse than none, because the documentation says it is in force.
expected_behaviors: The roles that make and review complexity decisions preload the skill in their frontmatter.
Both sides of the architecture decision hold it: the author and the independent reviewer.
failure_conditions: The skill exists and no role loads it.
Only the author holds it, so the review has no shared standard to review against.

checks.description: The role that buys the complexity.
The role that independently checks the purchase.
Story decomposition is where a layered design becomes six stories.
Every component introduced is a component someone runs, patches and is paged for.
Minimising dependencies is the same rule applied to the manifest.
